effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` EURC (0x60a3…db42 on Base) to the vault through transferFrom, using the signer's EURC allowance to the vault.
The vault mints steakEURC shares to `receiver`; the share count is derived from storage (total supply, total assets after fee accrual) with floor rounding, and has no minimum.
The vault supplies the EURC to Morpho Blue markets; this does not move other signer assets.
formats.shown: Intent "Deposit", with the EURC amount deposited, a constant "Share ticker: steakEURC" and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit does not show the number of steakEURC shares the receiver gets; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` No calldata parameter carries the share count or a minimum.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. A router with a minimum-shares parameter would allow a bound.

findings.title: deposit labels the EURC amount "Deposit asset" and adds a raw "Share ticker" field that holds no transaction value.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit fields: `"label": "Deposit asset"` on path `assets` (an amount), and `{"label": "Share ticker", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker"}`.
findings.fix: Rename the `assets` label to "Amount to deposit" and add interpolatedIntent "Deposit {assets} into steakEURC for {receiver}".

effects: The signer sends EURC to the vault through transferFrom; the amount is computed by the vault from storage with ceiling rounding and has no cap in calldata, bounded only by the signer's EURC allowance.
The vault mints exactly `shares` steakEURC to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Intent "Mint", with a constant "Deposit asset: EURC", the exact steakEURC shares minted and the address that receives them.

findings.title: mint does not show how much EURC leaves the signer; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);` ERC4626._deposit: `SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets);`. The screen shows only `"Deposit asset"` = `EURC` with no amount.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. Only the signer's EURC allowance bounds the amount.

findings.title: mint intent "Mint" does not say that the signer pays EURC to get the shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint: `"intent": "Mint"`, and there is no interpolatedIntent. The code takes EURC from the caller in ERC4626._deposit.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit EURC for steakEURC shares" and add interpolatedIntent "Pay EURC to mint {shares} for {receiver}".

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns steakEURC shares from `owner`; the count is computed from storage with ceiling rounding. When owner is the signer, the signer's shares burn.
When `owner` is not the signer, the vault spends the signer's steakEURC allowance from `owner` by that share count.
The vault sends exactly `assets` EURC to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Intent "Withdraw", with the exact EURC amount, the receiver and the owner whose shares pay for it.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many steakEURC shares the vault burns from owner; the vault computes it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` ERC4626._withdraw: `_burn(owner, shares);`.

findings.title: withdraw labels the share holder "Owner" and does not say that its shares are burned.
findings.evidence: descriptor withdraw: `"label": "Owner"` on path `owner`; ERC4626._withdraw: `if (caller != owner) { _spendAllowance(owner, caller, shares); } _burn(owner, shares);`.
findings.fix: Rename the label to "Burn shares from" and add interpolatedIntent "Withdraw {assets} to {receiver}".

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` steakEURC from `owner`. When owner is not the signer, it spends the signer's steakEURC allowance from owner by that amount.
The vault sends EURC to `receiver`; the amount is computed from storage with floor rounding and has no minimum.
formats.shown: Intent "Redeem", with the exact steakEURC shares to redeem, the receiver and the owner.

findings.title: redeem never names EURC as the asset the receiver gets, though sibling formats show it.
findings.evidence: ERC4626._withdraw: `SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets);` with `_asset` = EURC 0x60a3…db42. The descriptor redeem fields are only `shares`, `receiver`, `owner`, while mint shows `"Deposit asset"` = `$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker`.
findings.fix: Add a field {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} and change the intent to "Redeem steakEURC for EURC".

findings.title: redeem does not show how much EURC the receiver gets; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` No calldata parameter carries a minimum.
